byte_preservation_rule: Bytes are written verbatim. No normalization, re-encoding, whitespace change, HTML tidying, or character-set conversion is permitted before hashing or storage.
committed_output: the evidence ledger record only; never the notice bytes
execution_authorization: Execution is NOT authorized by OIC-CORPUS-WO-009. This document specifies the protocol and stops there.
failure_record_rule: Any failure writes a deterministic record carrying requested_url, the failure class, the exception type and message, and the capture_utc, with byte_length, sha256 and sha512 set to null. A failed recapture leaves CA-1, CA-2 and CA-4 BLOCKED_PENDING_CLEARANCE.
header_absence_rule: ETag and Last-Modified are recorded only when the origin returns them. A missing header is recorded as null and is never synthesized.
post_execution_gate: A successful recapture does not by itself change any disposition. It unlocks the evidence-review worksheet, whose completion is a separate reviewed step.
prior_failure_note: Recorded as an unreachable observation with no bytes and no hash. It is not a finding that reuse is prohibited and must not be read as one.
prohibited_substitution_rule: None of the above may stand in for captured bytes. A rights determination may cite only an artifact carrying a byte length and both digests.
prohibited_substitutions: screenshots or images of the page
prose copied or transcribed from a rendered view
a cached or third-party mirror of the notice
an archived snapshot in place of the live notice
a different Government of Canada terms page substituted for the cited URL
summarized or paraphrased terms in place of captured bytes
purpose: Specify a deterministic recapture of the licence notice that the publishers of CA-1, CA-2 and CA-4 cite in their own page footers. The prior freeze could not reach it from the execution environment, so those three sources fail closed with no reuse-permission evidence.

request.accept_encoding_rationale: Bytes must be frozen as the origin serves them. Transport compression would make the recorded digest depend on the client's negotiation rather than on the resource.
request.required_content_signature: Leading bytes, after stripping any UTF-8 BOM and leading whitespace, must begin with one of <!doctype html, <html. A response whose body is a WAF interstitial or an error page must be rejected even when the status line is 200.
